title: Governance Capabilities
paragraphs: “Never mind me. Look, the Shield Hero is over there. You’re a fan of the Shield Hero, aren’t you? I know him pretty well, so I’ll introduce you to him—come this way!”
“That’s right! My Father is here, too! I’d really like you to become friends with Kou, if possible.”
With that, I take Zou’s hand. But Zou doesn’t seem too enthusiastic about it.
“Um…”
“That’s the Spear Hero. You’ve heard rumors about him, right?”
“Ah, the one who’s not only known for quelling unrest all over the place but is also said to be monstrously strong… Is that the real deal?”
“Have I ever lied to you before?”
“Yes.”
Have I? I have absolutely no trust in you, Panda!
“I’m not lying this time. Apparently, the Spear Hero has knowledge of the future. You know something about Elmelo too, don’t you? Spill it.”
“His family home’s been taken over by the Mammoth family, and his foster parent is… I think it’s a mouse named Janon.”
“W-why do you know that!?”
“Elephants are really good at singing!”
Oh, come to think of it, he might get along well with Fleon-chan, who loves singing. Let’s introduce them later.
“Elmelo sings?”
“H-hold on a sec!”
For some reason, the elephant started acting all wary, with an expression that looked like he was in a bind.
“Anyway, he knows a lot of things. Why not just come along and see for yourself, even if you think you’re being tricked?”
“I’ve got a bad feeling about this, though…”
“Well then, let’s go!”

I took the Elephant by the hand and led him along. He really is a good Elephant, after all. He was a bit wary, but he let me lead him by the hand. As we made our way toward the audience seats, I spotted my Father and the others. They were all looking in our direction and waving at us.
“Heyyy, Elmelo-chan!”
Just then, Big Sister’s older sister waved and called out to us.
“――!? Rasa! Wait, he’s pulling me! Hey—he’s just dragging me like this, aaaaaaaah! He’s dragging me! Who is this guy? How strong is he?! Aaaaaah!”
The Elephant seems to be making a commotion. What on earth is going on?
“Wow, heroes really do have superhuman strength, don’t they… I’m surprised you came over without even noticing you were dragging Elmelo along.”
The Panda running beside me is saying something. When I look back, the Elephant is lying on the ground, still being dragged by my hand. Hmm?
“Elephant, are you okay?”
“Motoyasu! You shouldn’t have dragged him here like that.”
“Was I being forceful? I didn’t mean to do that in the slightest.”
“Well… when Sadeena-san waved to call him over, he actually tried to stop, but you just kept running and dragged him along.”
“Oh, that was rude of me. I’m truly sorry.”
When I let go of his hand, Elephant staggered to his feet. I’ve truly been rude. I trust Zou, so I didn’t mean to be disrespectful.
“I’m sorry. Motoyasu-kun didn’t mean any harm. I’ll talk to him myself, so please forgive him, won’t you?”
“N-no… don’t worry about it…”
“Um, you’re Elmelo, right?”
“So this is the Shield Hero, huh?”
“I’m Naofumi Iwatani. Nice to meet you.”
“Y-yes. My name is Elmelo Puhant.”
Zou saluted his father with a nervous expression.
“He’s so big…”
Your father is looking up at Zou.
“Elmelo-chan, it’s been a while!”
Zou is slinking backward away from Big Sister’s older sister. Is there something going on between him and his older Big Sister?
“Sadeena, Elmelo seems really wary of you. Did you do something to upset him?”
“Huh? Did I do something to Elmelo, Big Sister? As long as it wasn’t something like competing against him in a match, I don’t think he’d have any complaints, right?”
“Well, it’s only natural he’d be wary of you. I’d rather stay away from you too, if I could.”
“Naofumi, it’s definitely because of Sadeena’s drinking habits. He’s wary of getting completely drunk in a drinking contest.”
Itsuki picks up on this and speaks up.
“Ah… I kind of thought that might be it, but is that it?”
“Y-yes.”
Kokuri and Elephant nod.
“Oh my? Elmelo-chan is such a shy one, isn’t she?”
“It’s not even on that level… your drinking contest.”
“Don’t worry. The Shield Hero here is a monster that surpasses even this Uwa-bami. If she gets all over you, just shove her onto him and you’ll be able to escape.”
“Listen… Lars-chan,”
Her father admonishes her with exasperation. She’s being treated like some kind of exotic beast, but there’s no doubt about Father’s ability to hold his liquor.
“Naofumi-chan can hold his liquor better than me—how wonderful! Eek!”
Big Sister’s older sister is introducing my Father with high energy. Elephant is giving her a look that says, “Are you serious?” It’s true, though.
“If you say so, I suppose it must be true… though I’m skeptical about just how true it is…”
“Um, do you think I’m not the Shield Hero?”
“No… as for that… how should I put it… it’s just that when you say it, I somehow accept it right away. I wonder why.”
“Ah, I get that feeling.”
Tiger Guy steps in to say something.
“You can tell at a glance that this guy’s some kind of mysterious character.”
“Is that so, Naofumi-san? Is there something going on?”
“I don’t know.”
“If you take a nap in a field, you’ll get swarmed by wild monsters, Naofumi.”
“He must have some kind of special ability. Probably ‘Immunity to Drunkenness’ and ‘Animal Friends’ or something like that.”

Ah, come to think of it, back at the first Itsuki, my Father mentioned that he had some kind of special ability, too. It seems that as the Shield Hero, I sometimes get a sense of Demi-Humans and Beastmen.
“I’d really appreciate it if you’d just wake him up, though.”
“So this is Elmelo-san? I’m Itsuki Kawasumi, the Bow Hero. And this is Ren Amaki, the Sword Hero.”

“Come to think of it, when Panda and Naofumi were making a racket in their room at that inn in Siltvelt, someone mentioned an elephant. Panda… considering Larsazusa, it sounds like the guy we saw there.”
“I wonder about that.”
“I do have one relative living in the town below Siltvelt Castle, though…”
“Didn’t you and Larsa stop by there once? Did you forget? Maybe he saw us then?”
Wow, Elephant has a great memory.
“Father, this Elephant is facing various problems back home. That’s why I’d like you to lend a hand in various ways.”
“It’s rare for Motoyasu-kun to single out a specific person and make a request like this.”
“True. What exactly does this person do?”
“He’s a good Elephant who became friends with Kou and was kind to him in all sorts of ways, you know.”
“So it’s not just bitter grumbling, Motoyasu.”
“I didn’t realize such human emotions still remained in you.”
HAHAHA, as always, Itsuki’s mouth brings nothing but trouble. But even Ren is saying something he shouldn’t.
“That’s a different story from Takt, who says he hasn’t killed enough even after already murdering someone so gruesomely.”
“Wait… in terms of personality, he might actually be similar to Naofumi. I mean, in the sense that he was kind to Kou and the Filolials, so they remembered him.”
“Either way, he’s the lucky one. Even in future loops, every time he sees them, he’ll feel indebted to them and try to help them like that.”
“I’m so jealous. Here I am, having to fight the terror of brainwashing.”
“Absolutely. It’s almost enough to make you resentful.”
Ren and Itsuki are glaring at Elephant for some reason. What’s going on? Do they have a problem with this nice Elephant?
“Hmm… Should I say something to him?”
“N-no…”
Elephant is looking at me with a troubled expression. That’s weird… No, wait—if you take your Father to Elephant’s parents’ house, Elephant will surely find the courage to do the same!

“Exactly. Naofumi, how about hiring Elmelo for now to help out with various things? If we say he built up a track record while employed by Naofumi, the Shield Hero, that’ll fulfill the Spear Hero’s wish too.”
“That’s true. Motoyasu-kun has asked me to, too, and personally, I’d like to hire Elmelo—a famous fighter from Zeltoble—but is that okay? I want him to come, even if he thinks he’s being tricked.”
“O-okay. I’ll consider it depending on the hiring fee.”
Elephant nodded nervously at his Father. Panda tilted her head and glanced over at me and my Rival.
“That’s his true self. It’s a hassle to push him too hard, so it’s better to just keep quiet for now.”
“Yeah, yeah. Seriously, what can you do? Elmelo… you absolutely must refuse any invitations to the banquet from Uwabami! Otherwise, things will get really messy!”
“I know that, Rasa! Seriously… it’s been a while since I’ve seen you, and now you’ve turned into something incredible… the feast… you’ve gotten so round… you wouldn’t dare!”

Elephant looked at the panda and the Big Sister’s older sister as if he’d suddenly realized something, and his face turned pale. His Father, too, had a pale smile, his expression seemingly frozen in place.
“Oh my—”
“Sadeena, please show some restraint.”
“Oh well—maybe I’ll ask the Magic shop for a shrinking potion next time.”
“What do you mean, ‘oh well,’ Sadeena!? You’re not compromising at all! I’m hiring Elmelo at Motoyasu’s request, after all! I’m asking you to make sure you turn him down firmly too!”
“Yes! As the Shield Hero commands!”
With a “Zubish!” Elephant performed a magnificent Siltvelt-style salute.
“Are we getting another one?”
“Naofumi-san, you’re really an expert.”
“Did you two hear that? Wait, Itsuki, you weren’t listening through those headphones, were you? If you didn’t hear any more of that, I’m going to go get them with everything I’ve got.”
“Oops… my apologies.”
“Well, Elmelo is actually quite useful, you know. So rest assured, there’s a good reason to bring him along.”
And just like that, we managed to recruit Elephant as one of our own.

We then took Elephant to the village that Father was trying to rebuild and asked him to help out with various tasks. Since he was naturally strong to begin with, he became powerful in no time once we trained him. On top of that, we happened to go help with the reconstruction of the neighboring town that Éclair was supposed to be rebuilding. While assisting with miscellaneous tasks as the lord’s assistant, it became clear that asking Zou about the town’s reconstruction efforts and governance was more accurate and faster than asking Éclair. Since he’s an earth magic user, they say his skills are also applicable to civil engineering. Éclair had come over to vent to my Father and her Rival.
“Ms. Éclair, you’ve got it rough, don’t you?”

I muttered that after Father had put Éclair to bed—she’d gotten completely drunk after being hassled by Big Sister’s older sister while venting at Father’s house. By the way, Rival and I were there too. Ren and Itsuki declined to join us, not only because they can’t drink, but also out of concern that Big Sister’s older sister’s drinking habits might get out of hand.
“Looks like Elmelo had an unexpected talent after all…”

Panda was also at the drinking party and had been listening to Éclair’s antics. By the way, I’ve left Kou in Elephant’s care. When I asked him, Kou graciously agreed. Though, as expected, he was looking a bit down…
“Apparently, she learned how to govern a fiefdom from her foster parent, so she’s actually quite capable. Gaelion, you know that, right?”
“Éclair specializes in combat; she isn’t very good at domestic affairs.”
“She just needs a little study to come into her own. In fact, in the Wild Naofumi world, she’s managed to govern quite effectively.”
“Is that so…”
“Well, for now, it’s safer to leave it to Elmelo, since that will speed up the reconstruction.”
Zou really is quite capable, isn’t he?
“It seems he’s showing real motivation now that the Shield Hero has entrusted him with the task… Knights are such practical creatures, aren’t they?”
“By the way, there are people at Elmelo’s family home who look up to him. Having them around boosts efficiency thanks to their loyalty.”
“It’s Chugi the Mouse!”
“Motoyasu-kun…”
For some reason, my Father is giving me a look of exasperation. I wonder why?
“So the people who admire Elmelo are mice?”
“Her foster parents are. It’s kind of like a kinship bond.”
“Hmm… A relationship between an Elephant and a mouse, huh? That’s quite a fancy concept.”
“I don’t really understand a Hero’s sensibilities, but it seems like he’s feeling a sense of romance here.”
“I’d like to help solve Elmelo’s troubles eventually, but I wonder how I should go about it…”

“That’s where Elmelo—the one Naofumi hired from Siltvelt—comes in; she’s quite capable. Just say something like, ‘It’d be a problem if anyone other than her were sent,’ and her stock should rise significantly.”
“Including a safety net… Either way, it’ll be a big help, so that’s good. Sorry about that, Éclair.”
That means Éclair’s abilities are inferior to Zou’s.
“Elmelo-chan is such a tease—she runs away whenever I try to invite her to a party! Big Sister, what should I do?”
“Sadeena, my partner Lars-chan and I will handle that part, so please be patient. Otherwise, I’ll be the one in trouble.”
“Oh my—”

Big Sister’s older sister is gazing at Father with more adoration than in any other loop. After all, this is a loop where they’re mutually in love. It’s a far cry from her aloof demeanor in the first world.
“I really wish you’d stop dragging me into this already…”
“Lars-chan, please don’t run away. Otherwise, I’ll be in big trouble.”
